Engineer Rashid Granted Interim Bail for Father's Death Rites

Engineer Rashid, currently in custody, has been granted interim bail to attend the death rites of his late father. The decision allows him temporary release for the 'chahlum' ceremony, a significant observance in Islamic tradition. This development was reported by the Awami Ittehad Party (AIP).
